x-e-m1-01.title: Apa Ben bakal teka ing pesta? Nliti teges sing didhelikake ing wangsulane.
x-e-m1-01.goal: Pisahna wangsulan Ben baris demi baris, bedakake sing wis mesthi lan sing isih durung, banjur menehi panilaian tanpa mesthekake dheweke bakal teka utawa ora.
x-e-m1-01.material:
Dialog Jisu lan Ben (mung tulisan, tanpa gambar):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.

x-e-m1-01.thinking.2: Misahake masalah sing wis rampung karo sing isih ana.
x-e-m1-01.prereq.0: Teges ekspresi gampang kaya might, probably, lan check with.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.prompt: Wacanen dialog nganti pungkasan banjur pilih panilaian paling trep apa Ben bakal teka.

x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.c: Dolanan bal-balan esuk lan pesta jam 4 p.m. Bandhingna wektune.

x-e-m1-01.s.s2.prompt: Tulis 2-3 ukara basa Korea kanggo menehi alesan panilaian mau. Kutip paling ora siji ekspresi Inggris Ben lan kandhanana apa sing wis mesthi lan apa sing isih durung.

x-e-m1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Banjur goleki sing isih durung saka tembung pungkasan Ben lan tulisen.

x-e-m1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Apa ora nggawe pratelan mesthi yen dheweke bakal utawa ora bakal teka?
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.model.0: Dolanan bal-balan esuk lan pesta jam 4 p.m., mula wektune ora tumpang tindih. Nanging Ben kandha Let me check with my mom first, mula idin ibune isih dibutuhake lan durung dingerteni.

x-e-m1-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wangsulan apik sing misahake rasa kesel.
